hook.name: AsymmetricFee_100bp_300bp
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that sets the LP fee by swap direction only: 1% (10,000 hundredths of a bip) when token0 is paid in, 3% (30,000 hundredths of a bip) when token1 is paid in. Only compatible with pools using the dynamic fee flag; reverts during initialization otherwise. No owner, setters, or mutable state after deployment.
